name: milume
install: curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh && "$HOME/.local/bin/uv" sync --extra demo --group dev

terminals.name: marimo-landmarks
terminals.command: export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" && uv run marimo edit demos/landmarks.py --headless --no-sandbox --no-token --host 0.0.0.0 -p 2718
